translations.web: whom God raised up, having freed him from the agony of death, because it was not possible that he should be held by it.
translations.bsb: But God raised Him from the dead, releasing Him from the agony of death, because it was impossible for death to keep Him in its grip.
translations.kjv: Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.
